name: freezeHeader
label: Freeze row header
description: Allows users to keep header visible while scrolling to another area in the pivot.

name: freezeFooter
label: Freeze row footer
description: Allows users to keep footer visible while scrolling to another area in the pivot.

name: showPivotExpanded
label: Show pivot expanded
description: Enable to show fully expanded pivot table. Otherwise only the first level of row grouping is shown.

name: freezeFirstColumn
label: Freeze first column
description: The first column remains visible while scrolling.

name: showAlternateRowColors
label: Show alternative row colors
description: Toggle on to display background color for alternating rows. This can make reading the pivot data easier.

name: showAlternateColumnColors
label: Show alternative column colors
description: Toggle on to display background color for alternating columns. This can make reading the pivot data easier.

name: showRowDividers
label: Display row lines
description: Displays border row lines to show separate rows.

name: firstColumnMaxWidth
label: First column max width, in px
description: Limits width of first column. When active, specify max width of first column. Max width cannot be less than width of first column header. Lower values will be ignored.

name: wrapColumnHeader
label: Wrap column headers
description: Breaks header text into lines matching content width, min. limit 100px. Does not apply to first column.

name: truncateColumnHeader
label: Truncate column headers
description: Ends header with ellipsis (...) when content width exceeded, min. limit 100px. Does not apply to first column.

name: showColumnDividers
label: Display column lines
description: Displays border column lines to show separate columns.

name: showRowAggregate
label: Show row total
description: Final column shows total of each row, depending on metric aggregation.

name: showColumnAggregate
label: Show column total
description: Final row shows total of each column, depending on metric aggregation.

name: showSubAggregate
label: Show parent row totals
description: For a hierarchy of rows, each parent row shows total of all child rows per column, depending on metric aggregation.

name: enableDrilldown
label: Enable drilldown
description: When selected, enables an event handler to allow users to click a visualization value or section.

name: showZero
label: Show 0 when no data available
description: Choose the display format when there is no value in the selected dataset or for the configuration

name: userInfo
label: User information
description: User information provided by UXF context binding.
